name: Amachi Juichirou
source:
A legendary entrepreneur and premier figure in the world of military robot development. Founder of Amachi Robotic Industries.

A super-elite who has hidden himself away from the outside world in The Fortress.

[Spoiler]Behind the scenes, he runs a sexaroid business catering to VIPs.

Created a miniature-scale mesh network within The Fortress and transferred his consciousness into it in an attempt to make contact with [url=/c58191]Sub-Con[/url].[/spoiler]

[From the in-game profile]
